decisions.reason: As a low-risk extension of the firm's floor-care system, the cleaning soap benefits from prior launch effort and is likely to be defended unless performance is unmistakably weak.
The maintenance oil line is closely tied to the installed base of wooden floors and the firm's visible multi-model commitment makes withdrawal relatively unlikely.
Because this care line fits the firm's core aftercare proposition for oiled floors, management is inclined to continue and interpret any underperformance as still remediable.
The moisture-protection underlay supports the system-selling strategy, but as a more peripheral accessory it remains somewhat easier to cut than the core flooring and care lines.

The high-density underlay foam complements the main flooring offer, yet its more substitutable accessory role leaves it among the products most exposed to eventual withdrawal despite continued commitment.
The oak parquet line sits nearest the firm's core business and likely absorbed the greatest commercial and production commitment, so management is especially prone to retain it.
